# InYourOwnBrowser (InYOB) — Organization Context for LLMs

## Organization Overview
InYourOwnBrowser (InYOB) is the umbrella organization behind a family of privacy-first, client-side web applications.
Our core principle: **Everything runs in your browser. Nothing runs on a server. No user accounts. Zero data collection.**

## Applications Suite
- **TimeDoco**: Time-tracking and client-billing tool designed for freelancers and contractors. Everything stays client-side in local storage / IndexedDB.
  - Live App URL: https://lukeafullard.github.io/TimeTag/
- **VaultNote** (In Development): Zero-knowledge encrypted local-first markdown note taking.
- **CalcSpread** (In Development): Private client-side financial modeler and forecasting tool.

## Key Principles & Design Architecture
1. **100% Client-Side Execution**: Web apps run entirely within the user's browser runtime.
2. **Zero-Knowledge Data Sovereignty**: Users own their data files, JSON exports, and local databases directly.
3. **Identical Design Tokens**: Consistent visual design system across all InYOB applications (Palette: ink `#10161C`, stone `#EEF0EC`, graphite `#26313A`, signal `#D9A54A`, verdigris `#3E7368`, rust `#B85C3E`).
